Goldman Sachs Alternatives closed West Street Capital Partners IX, the ninth vintage of its flagship buyout platform, at $9.6 billion. The firm raised $11.7 billion across its private equity strategies, including more than $1.6 billion at the first close of West Street Asia Equity Partners I and $500 million for related co-investment vehicles. Institutional and high-net-worth investors in North America, Europe and the Middle East committed capital, as did Goldman Sachs and its employees.

Goldman Sachs Alternatives invests in privately held companies and other alternative assets on behalf of institutional and individual clients. West Street Capital Partners IX will make predominantly control-oriented investments in upper-middle-market companies in services, financials, technology, healthcare, consumer and energy transition. West Street Asia Equity Partners I targets control-oriented middle-market deals and select growth investments across Asia Pacific. Since 1986, the private equity team has invested more than $89 billion globally. Goldman Sachs has more than $706 billion in alternatives assets.
